name: XlSeriesNameLevel
description: Series-name-level constants passed to and returned by the Chart.SeriesNameLevel property.

constants.name: xlSeriesNameLevelNone
constants.description: Sets no series names in the chart.

constants.name: xlSeriesNameLevelCustom
constants.description: Indicates literal data in the series names.

constants.name: xlSeriesNameLevelAll
constants.description: Sets series names to all series name levels within range on the chart. The default.
